answer: Graduated entry toll. Each new identity enters through the jetty, a metered probation channel: for K epochs it pays an admission fee equal to the median honest payout, enforced inside the payout rule, so unbonded young accounts collect zero. Each fee seals a layer of the account's shale reserve, forfeited on reset. Birth height is final, so parallel identities cannot share progress. Probation closes only after surviving a synthetic gale of load tests. Attacker cost is linear: n puppets each pay n median fees per epoch, no bulk discount; an honest user pays once.
